verdict.rationale: Slack documents a running, dated deprecation changelog with migration windows, including an extended classic-app deprecation date of November 16, 2026, so deprecation communication is a first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence shows explicit API versioning (version identifiers or pinning), and the material reads as a log of announcements rather than a formal written policy. The OpenAPI spec repo shows the API surface is documented but not that it is versioned. missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme or version pinning, a formal written deprecation policy with stated guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: api.slack.com/changelog/deprecations is a running, dated log of API deprecation announcements with migration windows
We're pushing the deprecation date for classic apps to November 16, 2026.
